title: Chapter 522 - 522 Waiting; Time'S Up!
content:
Chapter 522 - 522 Waiting; Time'S Up!

Chapter 522 - 522 Waiting; Time's Up!

522 Waiting; Time’s Up!

There were helicopters and drones flying in the sky, amidst the buildings and forests of Wuka City. They broadcasted all the scenes to all the major video websites around the world in real-time.

They showed the same tall buildings and empty streets…

Everything was so boring.

If it were in the past, no one would stop and watch for a minute.

Today…

This live broadcast attracted the attention of countless people around the world.

Bullet comments filled the screen.

Xiu: [In the past, I often wanted to go to Bear Country to play, but my wallet was too thin. Now that I’m watching the live broadcast, it can be considered a dream come true.]

MAKE: [The buildings seem a little outdated.]

Gesley: [The architecture is a little outdated, but the greenery is indeed not bad! OMG! What was that? Wild bear! I actually saw a wild bear!]

Clark: [That bear is so fat!]

JJ: [Bear Country actually moved all the residents of Wuka City? In five days, all the residents have been moved away. Who knows how long it’ll take to move them back?]

KK: [Without the help of the authorities, it’ll probably take at least a month.]

SKE: [Previously, I was still a little skeptical about the news posted on the internet. They said that Bear Country was forcefully evacuating the residents. Now that I’ve seen the live broadcast, I believe it!

[Look, many of the doors weren’t closed in time, and the streets are a mess.]

Gervais: [With so many doors left open, there’ll probably be a lot of theft cases when the residents are transferred back.]

GG: [Hey, there are a few stray dogs over there. They’re eating bones. Perhaps the relocation of residents is a good thing for them. They can eat their fill!]

Mike: [Happy stray dogs.]

YY: [The stray dogs may become the biggest winner!]

Viktor: [I’ve been watching the live broadcast since I woke up. So, what about the earthquake? What about the 9.1 magnitude earthquake?]

Fries: [I’ve been watching it since midnight!]

Tretus: [Let me tell you something. A magnitude 9 earthquake is equivalent to 477 million tons of TNT. If you don’t know what 477 million tons of TNT means, let me give you another example… This is almost the energy of a million nuclear weapons! Now you know how terrifying it is, right? The special effects of all blockbusters can’t compare to the real thing.]

Mark: [After hearing what you guys said, I suddenly look forward to seeing whether Lin Fan’s earthquake prediction device is really accurate. Even though I think it’s impossible.]

Tauren: [Didn’t Hua Nation say that the earthquake would start at 9 o’clock? There are only five minutes left before it’s nine o’clock in Hua Nation.]

…

Hua Nation.

Generally speaking, there should always be people talking, chatting, or constantly clapping in the conference room.

However, at this moment…

The old man sitting at the head of the table, as well as the men and women in formal attire, all raised their heads and watched the live broadcast silently.

They looked at the time that kept jumping, and their faces were filled with solemnity and a faint worry.

“Three minutes left,” someone muttered.

…

Jiangbei University.

Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, Liu Qianqian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others also gathered together to discuss.

However, as long as Lin Fan came…

They would all immediately separate and quickly enter a learning state.

However…

Today, there was an unprecedented exception.

Even though Lin Fan had already arrived at the office, they were still gathered in front of the computer. Their eyes were burning as they stared at the screen, their faces filled with nervousness.

Hao Zhiwu looked at the bullet comments that kept flashing on the screen and could not help but say, “Professor Lin…”

Before he could finish, Lin Fan interrupted, “The earthquake prediction device will never make a mistake.”

It was not that Lin Fan had foresight and knew what Hao Zhiwu wanted to say.

It was because Hao Zhiwu had asked the same question too many times.

It was the sixth time today.

Lin Fan’s reply was not perfunctory at all.

This was the truth!

The earthquake prediction device would never make a mistake!

This was because this was a product obtained from the system.

In addition, Lin Fan also had the most detailed knowledge of earthquake predictors. He knew the functions of earthquake predictors.

Hao Zhiwu could not help but feel a little embarrassed. “Alright.”

Then, he looked at the time on the bottom right corner of the computer and took a deep breath. “Two minutes to nine.”

…

Bear Country.

In the conference room.

The man with a buzz cut and the men and women in suits stared at the live broadcast screen without blinking.

The atmosphere in the conference room was extremely gloomy.

Many people had worried expressions on their faces.

This was because they were the ones who decided to evacuate the residents of Wuka City… as well as the residents of the surrounding cities.

If the earthquake prediction results were wrong, then they would also bear a lot of responsibility.

At this moment, a middle-aged man whispered, “There’s only one minute left before it’s 9:00 in Hua Nation.”

As soon as he said this…

The atmosphere in the already gloomy meeting room instantly became extremely heavy.

Many people’s breathing became heavy.

Nervousness, uneasiness!

…

At this moment, in the live broadcast.

The bullet comments were still flooding the screen.

Haridas: [The earthquake hasn’t happened yet? I almost dozed off.]

Jett: [Yeah, so many people are waiting.]

Gedd: [No way. Do you guys really think that Wuka City will have a 9.1 magnitude earthquake?]

Meng Shaokandi: [Don’t worry, no one believes it. Everyone is just joining in the fun.]

Dr. Yamamoto: [Earthquake forecast will still have to depend on Island Nation! Our Island Nation can accurately predict earthquakes 10 seconds in advance. Ours is the real earthquake prediction device!

[The earthquake prediction device in Island Nation has not responded, so the outcome is destined.]

Let’s Go: [In the past, Lin Fan even wanted to say that he was Corean. We Coreans were also considering whether it was true or not. Now, it seems like there’s no need to consider it anymore. It’s fake! He’s definitely not Corean!]

SKY: [Let me tell everyone that there are still 10 seconds until 9 PM in Hua Nation! We’re about to witness a miracle!]

Heavy Rain: [9!]

SSSSS: [8!]

Emperor Cage: [7!]

Flower World: [6!]

…

In an instant, the entire screen was completely covered in numbers.

That feeling was simply not like watching a live broadcast.

Instead, it was like one was watching numbers fly past the screen. Everyone was dazzled.

However, they did not get tired of it.

At the same time, some people had a faint sense of anticipation in their hearts.

There were also some people who had prepared a large amount of mocking words and articles, ready to be sent at any time.

Nicholas: [3!]

Hunter: [2!]

Alexander: [1!]

Just as countless ‘1s’ covered the screen…

On the live broadcast screen, the originally incomparably calm skyscrapers, streets, villages, mountains… Suddenly, they trembled violently and emitted an extremely terrifying loud sound.

It was like the roar of an abyss beast!

It was ear-piercing and terrifying!
